name: Frida Live Instrumentation
author: igwtech
description: Drops Ultimate-ASI-Loader + frida-gadget into the NC2 game directory for in-Wine instrumentation. The gadget binds 127.0.0.1:27042 in **wait** mode — game pauses at DllMain until orchestrator connects, then proceeds. Companion orchestrator at ceres-j/tools/frida_re hooks ws2_32!recvfrom/sendto for UDP (auto-decrypted via LFSR+CFB) plus kernel32!ReadFile/WriteFile + ntdll!NtDeviceIoControlFile for TCP frames, plus a DirectInput8 chain hook for keyboard injection via rpc.exports.dikPress.
